Macrons

Consonantal i

Theme

Clothes & getting dressed

shoelace noun

also shoelaces

our formation

vincula calceōrum

shoelaces

A description, from vinculum, vinculī n., tie or fastening.

Other words

  • 1corrigia: second vowel left unmarked (Lewis & Short corrī^gia, which marks its length as doubtful). Traupman 117 and Morgan–Owens s.v. shoelace print it unmarked.

    corrigia1, corrigiae f.

    noun, first declension · also used · classical · Traupman 117, 377; M-O s.v. shoelace; Cic. Div. 2.84: abruptiō corrigiae, a snapped shoelace as a bad omen

See also tie, shoe.

SourcesLewis & Short: vinculum

John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 117, 377. Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. shoelace.
